label: Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh
tagline: Ghats, aartis and one of the world's oldest living cities.

hotels.name: Stops Hostel Varanasi
hotels.note: Hostel in a heritage building beside Assi Ghat; rooftop river views.

hotels.name: Hotel Alka
hotels.note: Simple rooms right on the ghats with a terrace over the Ganga.

hotels.name: Suryauday Haveli
hotels.note: Restored 19th-century riverside haveli, calm and full of antiques.

hotels.name: Hotel Ganges Grand
hotels.note: Modern hotel a short walk from the main aarti ghat.

hotels.name: BrijRama Palace
hotels.note: 1812 palace on the water's edge, reached by boat; rooms face the river.

hotels.name: Taj Ganges
hotels.note: Colonial-style hotel in 40 acres of gardens with a large pool.

things_to_do.name: Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat
things_to_do.note: The evening fire ceremony; arrive 45 minutes early for a good step.

things_to_do.name: Sunrise boat ride
things_to_do.note: The classic rowed-boat trip past all the ghats; leave at first light.

things_to_do.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
things_to_do.note: One of the twelve Jyotirlingas; phones and bags are not allowed in.

things_to_do.name: Sarnath
things_to_do.note: Where Buddha gave his first sermon; stupa, museum and monastery ruins.

things_to_do.name: Banaras Hindu University and Bharat Kala Bhavan
things_to_do.note: Leafy 1,300-acre campus with a museum of miniatures and sculpture.

eateries.name: Kashi Chat Bhandar
eateries.note: The tomato chaat everyone queues for; eat it standing.

eateries.name: Blue Lassi Shop
eateries.note: Tiny 1925 shop serving lassi in clay cups; walls covered in traveller notes.

eateries.name: Deena Chat Bhandar
eateries.note: Bustling chaat corner near the main ghat.

eateries.name: Canton Royale
eateries.note: Sit-down restaurant with a proper Banarasi menu, a rarity here.
